svg.title: Virtual Assistant — Detail
svg.desc: Editable reconstruction from virtual-assistant-154616-hero-loaded.png. Only public hero artwork is raster: exact crop (0,398,576,628) from virtual-assistant-154926-hero-expanded.png, converted to sRGB. Header, paragraphs, link and controls are native editable objects. Native sans-serif font and vector icons are approximations. Cursor and hover glow omitted.

g.text: As your Virtual Assistant, I'm here to help you find
the information you need about your department.
For instant answers to your questions, click
to chat with me or visit the department website
